subject: Retention request: Finova competitive counter & migration runbook
messages:
From: Jane Carroll <jane.carroll@finova.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal consideration + competing offer (CloudForge)

Markus —

Thanks for the continued partnership. Procurement looped me in; we have a renewal coming up for our ML inference footprint and CloudForge just sent a bundled offer that materially lowers our unit costs if we migrate and commit for 18 months. Key bullets from their offer:
- 25% lower per-token price for committed 18-month plan (with 2.5M token monthly commit)
- Free migration assistance + 40 hours of engineering support
- 3 months free on ramp accelerated credit

We value the performance and observability we've gotten with Redwood, but the economics are getting tight — we need your best retention counter and a migration runbook/cost-to-migrate assessment so procurement can compare apples-to-apples.

Attached: CloudForge_offer.pdf (redacted pricing pages).

Can you send something by Tuesday so we can share with our CFO and procurement?

Best,
Jane Carroll
Senior Procurement Manager
Finova Systems

---

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Jane Carroll <jane.carroll@finova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal consideration + competing offer (CloudForge)

Jane —

Appreciate the heads up and the offer details. We put together a retention counter and a short migration runbook to make the comparison straightforward. High-level proposal:

1) Pricing/term counter
- 12-month committed plan at 20% off list for the committed volume of 2.5M tokens/month (we can extend to 18 months at 22% off upon signature within 7 days)
- Additional 10% credit applied to first 2 months of usage (applied as bill credit)
- If you tier up to 3.5M tokens/mo within the first quarter, we will lock the 18-month pricing for the remainder of the term.

2) Migration & technical support
- 60 hours migration engineering credits (split across SE and infra), dedicated migration runbook and weekly checkpoint calls for first 8 weeks
- Sandbox replication support (data-free) and token-usage estimates validated against your last 3 months

3) Commercial concessions
- One-time onboarding credit equivalent to $30k (applied to first invoice)
- No data egress fees for first 6 months if migration occurs within 30 days of signing

4) Operational guarantees
- 99.9% SLA for dedicated endpoints included for the committed term
- Access to our Optimize team for 1 live tuning session to reduce per-token costs by batching/quantization guidance

Attached: redwood-retention-proposal-v1.pdf (pricing table + migration runbook summary).

If this looks acceptable I can route a clean SOW and redlines to your procurement. Marissa — looping you in to validate migration hours and sequencing. Rishi — this includes the $30k onboarding credit; want to flag if pricing committee needs to sign off on the 22%/18-month escalation language.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
(415) 555-0189

---

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing committee: Finova counter (internal)

Team —

I reviewed Markus's counter and the CloudForge materials. Guidance from Pricing: we can approve the 20% off / 12-month by default. Approving 22% off for 18 months requires a formal exception but can be signed off if we get:
- Signed LOI within 7 days, and
- Minimum annual committed spend >= $1.6M (or equivalent token commitment), and
- Exec sponsor confirmation for renewal measurement (email ok).

I'm OK to include the $30k onboarding credit and the 60 hours migration credit. Recommend we add a one-off migration SLA clause: we commit a single escalation window (48 hours) for the first 30 days post-cutover. Also propose a small sweetener: additional 5% renewal credit at year 1 if Finova meets the commit and no unplanned downtime > 2 hours.

Markus — if you want I can pre-approve the exception and get legal to fast-track the SOW and redlines; need a short note from you confirming the annual commit numbers and PoV timeline before I engage.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference

---

From: Jane Carroll <jane.carroll@finova.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Roger Blake <roger.blake@finova.com>, procurement@finova.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal consideration + competing offer (CloudForge)

Markus / Rishi —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the detailed counter. Finova is prepared to proceed on the following provisional terms:

- Accept 18-month commitment if pricing is locked at 22% off and onboarding credits/migration hours are confirmed in SOW
- We'll sign an LOI by EOD Tuesday if you can provide a clean SOW + DocuSign link with: pricing table, migration runbook, SLA clause, and the PO instructions (see attached PO_Template.docx)
- Procurement will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and your standard data processing addendum (DPA) included or referenced in the SOW

Roger Blake (cc) will be our procurement lead for contract execution — Roger, please coordinate with Markus on PO and redlines.

Attachments: PO_Template.docx

Looking forward to closing quickly.

Best,
Jane Carroll
Senior Procurement Manager
Finova Systems
